en.title: 3 arrested in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: An investigation into the 2011 death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu in prison has resulted in three arrests following detentions.

stories.title: Son dakika... Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında kritik gelişme: Gazeteci Selahattin Günday ve 2 ATT personeli tutuklandı!

en.title: Breaking: Journalist Selahattin Günday and 2 emergency medical technicians arrested in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: Journalist Selahattin Günday and two emergency medical technicians were detained and subsequently arrested in connection with the Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation.

stories.title: Gülistan Doku soruşturmasında 6'ıncı dalga: 7 ilde eş zamanlı operasyon

en.title: Sixth wave in Gülistan Doku investigation: Simultaneous operations in 7 provinces
en.summary: Operations were launched against 11 suspects in seven provinces as part of the Gülistan Doku investigation, which involves allegations of evidence tampering and obstruction.

stories.title: Başkanının yurt dışına kaçtığı iddia edilmişti: Pusula Portföy'den açıklama geldi

en.title: Statement from Pusula Portföy after chairman allegedly fled abroad
en.summary: Following allegations that Pusula Portföy chairman Muhammet Yarız fled the country, the company stated that its planned ownership transfer process with Tera Group continues unaffected.

stories.title: İstanbul’da bazı yollar trafiğe kapatılacak: Saat 10’da başlıyor

en.title: Some roads in Istanbul will be closed to traffic: Starting at 10 AM
en.summary: Istanbul will close certain roads in the Fatih, Beyoğlu, and Beşiktaş districts on September 13, 2026, due to the Yeşilay and 78 Event Bicycle Tour scheduled to take place that day.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA | Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: 3 şüpheli tutuklandı

en.title: BREAKING | New development in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation: 3 suspects detained
en.summary: In the investigation into the death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu, a second wave operation resulted in the detention of nine suspects, three of whom were referred for prosecution.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan’ın AKP’ye davet ettiği belediye başkanı YENİ Parti’ye katıldı

en.title: Mayor invited by President Erdoğan to AKP joins NEW Party instead
en.summary: Marmaris Mayor Acar Ünlü resigned from the CHP and joined the NEW Party, rather than accepting an invitation to join the AKP.

stories.title: Erdoğan, AKP'ye davet etmişti: Marmaris Belediye Başkanı Acar Ünlü, CHP'den istifa ederek YENİ Parti'ye katıldı

en.title: Erdoğan invited him to AKP: Marmaris Mayor Acar Ünlü resigns from CHP and joins NEW Party
en.summary: Marmaris Mayor Acar Ünlü, whom President Erdoğan had invited to join the AKP, resigned from the CHP and joined the NEW Party instead, stating the decision represents a continuation of his political journey.

stories.title: Sosyal medya fenomeni Semih Varol gözaltına alındı

en.title: Social media phenomenon Semih Varol detained
en.summary: A social media influencer was taken into custody after allegedly using profane language directed at police officers during a live broadcast on social media.

stories.title: Polise canlı yayında küfür etmişti: Sosyal medya fenomeni Semih Varol gözaltına alındı

en.title: Social media phenomenon Semih Varol detained after cursing at police during live broadcast
en.summary: A social media influencer was detained for allegedly using insulting language toward police officers during a live broadcast. Legal proceedings were initiated against him for insulting a public official.

stories.title: Polislere hakaret etmişti: Semih Varol gözaltına alındı

en.title: Semih Varol detained after insulting police
en.summary: A social media influencer was taken into custody after using derogatory language toward police officers during a live broadcast on TikTok.

stories.title: Düğündeki takılar gündem olmuştu: 'Vanlı Kara Haydar'ın eşi Çağla Öz gözaltına alındı

en.title: Çağla Öz, wife of 'Vanlı Kara Haydar', detained
en.summary: The wife of a man previously detained on money laundering charges related to a wedding was taken into custody in Istanbul. She is expected to be transferred to Van following processing.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında 3 şüpheli için tutuklama talebi

en.title: Arrest warrant sought for 3 suspects in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: In the second wave of operations regarding the death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu, 9 suspects were detained and processed. Three suspects face arrest requests while six face judicial supervision requests.

stories.title: Tera Yatırım'dan Pusula Finans Holding açıklaması

en.title: Tera Yatırım statement on Pusula Finans Holding
en.summary: Tera Yatırım announced that the acquisition process of Pusula Finans Holding and its subsidiaries continues and recent public developments have not altered the group's strategic and financial assessment.

stories.title: Dışişleri Bakanı Fidan İranlı mevkidaşı Erakçi ile telefonda görüştü

en.title: Foreign Minister Fidan speaks with Iranian counterpart Erakçi by phone
en.summary: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan held a telephone conversation with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Erakçi.

stories.title: FIBA 2026 Kadınlar Basketbol Dünya Kupası’nda finalin adı belli oldu

en.title: FIBA 2026 Women's Basketball World Cup final matchup confirmed
en.summary: The United States and France will face each other in the final of the FIBA 2026 Women's Basketball World Cup.

stories.title: Mehmet Fatih Tançalan’ın eşi Çağla Öz de gözaltında

en.title: Mehmet Fatih Tançalan's wife Çağla Öz also detained
en.summary: Çağla Öz, wife of businessman and social media personality Mehmet Fatih Tançalan from Van, has been detained in Istanbul.
